criteria.criterion: GET rotation is durably attempted before live replacement; a failed sidecar save retains the newest inline floor and a later retry converges.
criteria.evidence: binding_repository.py lines 262-279: save() calls get_rotation.save() FIRST (line 276), then only scrubs inline last_get_pass stamps if rotation save returned True (lines 277-278), then writes live store (line 279). If rotation save fails (returns False), inline floor is retained. test_binding_repository.py contains: test_save_persists_rotation_before_replacing_live, test_rotation_tempfile_failure_keeps_sidecar_old_and_live_new_with_floor, test_rotation_replace_failure_keeps_sidecar_old_and_live_new_with_floor, test_next_save_after_rotation_failure_converges_sidecar_from_inline_floor. test_get_rotation_heldout.py also covers: test_sidecar_tempfile_failure_does_not_abort_legacy_save, test_sidecar_replace_failure_retains_inline_floor_until_retry, test_legacy_only_store_materializes_equivalent_sidecar_on_save.
